Fingers and fingernails

Original: https://shrouded-lands.fandom.com/wiki/Fingers_and_fingernails

*The Market Pit is lit by candles made of human finger bones (28.04) *The mountain shepherds of Mt Scorshia eat human finger stew (02.04) *Lady Naideen is missing a finger (17.11) *The araneas of the Gloompatch flee men with a finger removed (23.08) *The Ferryman collects finger bone tolls (35.06) *Cloud halflings increasingly have six fingers or toes *Master Var has made a ship in a bottle out of fingernails (43.03) *Ships from the Isle of Thalanyl are covered with human fingernails (Jahur) *Droesh keeps his lover’s fingerbone around his neck. *There was a War of the Six-Fingered Hand *Those who wear the ring of the Honorable Society of Engineers without being a recognised member have their middle finger cut off.
